publication.title: iPhone OS Research Atlas
publication.scope: iPhone OS 1.1.4 / 4A102 and 3.1.3 / 7E18; native PinePhone execution, distinct QEMU gates and offline next-target study
publication.provenance: Original editorial synthesis of private project notebooks and experiment reports, with reviewed capture images, selected source excerpts and their provenance. Firmware, storage images, complete run artifacts and the implementation repository are not included.
publication.author: Felipe Guilherme Sabino

record.title: Larger legacy preview queue, measured on hardware
record.method: One physical two-slot versus six-slot comparison before the first still
record.observation: In the 1.1.4 comparison, distinct selected images increase from 7.8931 to 16.5198/s while native delivery changes from 29.6207 to 26.2787/s. Queue capacity changes from two to six.
record.limits: These are original-renderer selection counters, not proof of physical panel presentation. The pair uses unequal intervals and is not a measured 3.1.3 throughput result.
